_comment: Curated per-monster bring-chips (originally the RecommendedBring switch, moved to a token-free resource 2026-08-08). A rule matches on lowercased monster name, optionally narrowed by versionStartsWith; ALL matching rules' chips merge. 'rune': true chips pull the rune pouch along; a 'spellbook' field means the recommendation locks the trip to that book and the Arceuus folds stand down. Item ids gameval/GE-verified at encode time; poison/venom rows carry foundational wiki facts (venom: Zulrah line, Vorkath, the wilderness spiders, the Araxxor line; poison: KQ, Sarachnis, Scorpia).
